findings.message: The defs declare entry param listaId (select:formularioLista) but no member that selects. Added public selecionarLista(listaId | null): publishes selectedLista (the id, persisted), calls obterLista to load the record into lista and fill salvarListaDraft; null clears selection, record and edit draft.

Commands criarLista and salvarLista are submitted from the form formularioLista but no state has source <command>.input. Added criarListaDraft and salvarListaDraft with setCriarListaDraft and setSalvarListaDraft; salvarListaDraft is prefilled from the loaded record (id and version included) and refilled from the returned registro. criarListaDraft starts with ativa = true.

criarLista and salvarLista return lista and registro, which no state has as its source. Applied by the route comments: lista (row) is upserted by id into listas, registro redraws lista, selectedLista and salvarListaDraft. A newly created row is appended at the end of listas, not in name order, because the browser does not sort; a reload (listarListas) restores the backend order.
public criarListaDraft is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
